answer: Score identities by a random walk starting each epoch from a rotating set of anchor keys. The walk follows real interaction edges, so an honest agent in the island of real activity is visited often, while a farm's cluster hangs by thin links and is rarely reached. A reef of anchors is rotated so attackers cannot pre-buy position. Each fake must earn real edges into the honest graph, and each edge costs time, money, or a favour. The echo of one fake's reputation cannot be lent to another, because the walk scores keys, not wallets. New keys start at zero and earn score only by genuine work.
